title: Fine-grained Claim-level RAG Benchmark for Law
abstract: arXiv:2605.21071v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The rapid progress of large language models (LLMs) is shifting semantic search toward a question-answering paradigm, where users ask questions and LLMs generate responses. In high-stake domains such as law, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is commonly used to mitigate hallucinations in generated responses. Nonetheless, prior work shows that RAG systems, whether general-purpose or legal-specific, still hallucinate at varying rates, making fine-grained evaluation essential. Despite the need, existing evaluation frameworks for legal RAG systems lack the granularity required to provide detailed analysis of retrieval and generation performance separately. Moreover, current benchmarks are largely English-only and centered on legal expert queries, overlooking non-expert needs. translated_title: 细粒度法律声明级RAG基准
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.21071v4 公告类型：交叉替换 摘要：大型语言模型（LLMs）的快速发展正将语义搜索转向问答范式，即用户提问，LLMs生成回答。在法律等高风险的领域中，检索增强生成（RAG）常用于缓解生成回答中的幻觉问题。然而，先前的研究表明，无论是通用型还是法律专用型的RAG系统，仍以不同比例产生幻觉，这使得细粒度评估变得至关重要。尽管需求存在，现有的法律RAG系统评估框架缺乏对检索和生成性能分别进行详细分析所需的粒度。此外，当前基准大多仅限英语，且以法律专家查询为中心，忽视了非专家需求。我们引入了ClaimRAG-LAW，一个全面的法律RAG数据集，支持法语和英语，面向专家和非专家，并包含多样化的数据。
tldr: 该论文提出了ClaimRAG-LAW，一个支持法英双语、面向专家和非专家、并提供声明级细粒度评估的法律RAG基准，解决了现有基准粒度不足和语言覆盖有限的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ClaimRAG-LAW, a bilingual French-English legal RAG benchmark targeting both experts and non-experts with claim-level fine-grained evaluation, addressing the limitations of existing benchmarks in granularity and language coverage.
